_doc: Building upgrades (P3-16/P3-18/P3-21, owner 2026-11-20; doc 02 §4/§7/§9/§11). Each building has tracks; a track starts at level 0 with `base` and each bought level i (1..n) costs levels[i-1].reliquias Reliquias del Abuelo + .colones and sets the track's value to levels[i-1].value. Levels are bought in order. Effects (each building may use an effect once): rank_cap (max Casa Comunal skill rank; heroes already above it keep their ranks), rank_discount (fraction off rank prices), relief_bonus (fraction added to the stress relief rolled), cost_discount (fraction off the activity price), extra_slots (slots added to every activity), camp_extra_class_skills (class camp skills added to each fogata hand), lesson_discount (fraction off Guardabosques learn / fix prices), extra_stock (accessories added to the Feria Nocturna's weekly stall, P3-05b); cost_discount at the Feria is a fraction off its accessory prices, at the Taller off weapon/armor rank prices; weapon_rank_cap / armor_rank_cap (P3-05d) are the highest weapon / armor rank the Taller works (balance.json taller.*). Rules: scripts/domain/building_upgrades.gd. Reliquia sources: progression.json difficulties[].reliquias (objective cleared), balance.json upgrades.elite_reliquia_chance (elite or roaming mini-boss killed), curio outcome `reliquias`.
